model: robust short-scale residual proxy for isolated-impulse thresholds only
impulse_threshold: max(20, 6*sigma) AND above positive-load envelope if >=10 positive modeled samples
load_envelope: max(2*median_positive, median_positive+6*MAD_positive); protect ordinary-amplitude sparse load pulses
edge_guard: protect large foot-total transitions when >=3 channels coherently change beyond max(20,4*sigma); also protect broad nonzero-channel activation/deactivation
smoothing: disabled; no adaptive or other continuous smoothing executed
no_clock_policy: retain values; do not assume sampling frequency
boundaries: do not modify segment endpoints or invalid/gap/ambiguous rows
baseline: handled separately by unchanged airborne baseline core
parameter_selection: same v3 impulse thresholds and guards; no new tuning; only smoothing removed
limitations: residual includes real motion; impulses may include real impacts; offline future-neighbor access
physical_noise_distribution: not identified; no fitted Gaussian model or Gaussian efficacy claim
residual_scale_interpretation: Inherited MAD/sqrt(6) scale is a fixed threshold heuristic, not a measured sensor noise distribution
